content:
Emma: Good morning  starting onboarding kickoff for client Solace tomorrow. Core goals: reach a reproducible E2E demo, finalize success criteria tied to renewal signals, and hand off enablement artifacts. Who from Solace is attending? @Raj please confirm. :wave:

Raj: Solace will send PM + 2 backend devs + infra lead (Mira). I'll add them to the invite and share emails.

Claire: I'll own enablement. Plan: 20m product demo, 30m hands-on lab, 15m ops Q&A. Will record and publish a 1-pager + repo with examples.

Ben: I'll take infra & perf checks. Need staging jumpbox creds, staging API key, and an expected traffic profile. If they request Dedicated or Private deployment that will add ~10 business days. Tagging RISK-DEPLOYMENT.

Emma: Proposed 12-day sprint (lean):
```
Day 0: kickoff + contacts + SSO cert check
Day 1-2: API integration & smoke tests
Day 3-5: perf tuning & batching
Day 6-8: enablement + labs
Day 9-11: feedback capture + bug triage
Day 12: retro + exec readout / go-no-go
```
Can people flag blockers by EOD? :spiral_calendar:

Claire: Draft enablement deck link: https://go.redwood/solace-enable. Will post the hands-on repo tonight. Also plan a 2-question pulse after sessions (clarity + confidence).

Ben: Risk note  SSO cert exchange is the usual choke point. If certs are delayed >5 days we will lose clean telemetry and that pushes go-no-go. Tagging RISK-SSO. Also request their 95th pct latency target if they have one.

Raj: Confirmed Mira (infra) will share jumpbox details by EOD tomorrow and PM is jess@solace.co. They asked about data residency; they require EU-only for logs. Tagging RISK-DATA.

Emma: Proposed success criteria (draft): "integration green (smoke tests pass) + 3 core flows demonstrable + 95th pct latency <400ms on 512-token samples + post-training pulse >=80% positive." Thoughts?

Claire: I like it. Suggest adding "recorded demo uploaded" as a deliverable so exec can review asynchronously.

Ben: +1. Also: need staging API key by EOD tomorrow so we can run quantization + throughput runs. I'll queue perf runs once key available.

Emma: Owners: Claire = enablement & feedback, Ben = infra & perf, Raj = customer liaison, Emma = exec sync & escalation.

onboard-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.checklists/4872000000  includes owners, meeting links, deck, repo, and RISK tags (RISK-SSO, RISK-DATA, RISK-DEPLOYMENT).

Claire: I'll publish the repo and pre-read tonight and send invites for two training tracks (dev + ops).

Raj: I'll ask Mira to confirm EU residency constraints in writing and push jumpbox creds. If Solace insists on Private deployment I'll request a formal SOW and update timeline.

Ben: If jumpbox delayed, I'll flag here immediately. For perf baselines I'll run a 1k-token sample and post results to the checklist link.

Emma: Daily 10-min stand at 09:20 PST during the sprint. If anyone hits a blocker add RISK-XXX and we'll escalate. Thanks! :thumbsup:
